newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Egis plans 8pct '96 dividend, same as '95.
newsitem.headline: Egis plans 8pct '96 dividend, same as '95.

text.p: Hungarian pharmaceuticals company Egis Gyogyszergyar Rt plans to pay an eight percent dividend or 80 forints per share on its 1996 results, the company said in a statement on Friday.
Egis paid an eight percent dividend on 1995, too.
The company posted a pre-tax profit of of 5.62 billion forints on net sales of 24.69 billion forints in 1996, compared to a pre-tax profit of 4.90 billion on net sales of 19.81 billion in 1995.
Egis will hold its annual shareholders meeting on April 29.
